propositions: The planning corpus size assertion (PLANNING_CORPUS_SIZE = 113) drifts when historical tickets are reclassified or prefix resolution changes, because the corpus is re-derived from live ticket state at runtime rather than pinned by commit identity.

The backtest script's --check-planning-corpus mode fails on current main with corpus=114 (want 113), despite no recent changes causing the divergence, because the size constant is unstable against tracker mutations.

The corpus must be pinned by exact commit SHAs (PLANNING_CORPUS_COMMITS frozenset) rather than by count, so that the one-time hand-reviewed adjudication over a fixed commit set remains reproducible regardless of subsequent tracker churn.

The check-mode implementation should measure each pinned SHA directly and assert identity equality with the pin and flagged-set equality with ADJUDICATED_SUBSTANTIVE, rather than re-deriving membership from live ticket state.
